description: Robinhood Chain KOL scout leaderboard — which tracked KOLs are FIRST into tokens that other KOLs then follow. A first touch = a KOL buy of a token no KOL bought before (chain order), counted over [now-30d, now-4h]; followers = distinct OTHER KOLs buying within 4 h after. Per scout: n_first_touches_30d, swarm_3plus_pct / swarm_5plus_pct (share of touches followed by 3+ / 5+ KOLs), avg_followers_4h, scout_score + scout_tier S/A/B/C (null below min_first_touches). One KOL with several EVM addresses is one scout. 503 scout_scores_unavailable until the server function exists. Tier: PRO+.
name: rhc_kol_scout_leaderboard
